content.comment_body: Hello, After switching to the newer [product_name] hardware ([article_no]), I noticed that the inputs from the cursor keys seem to stay active for a longer period compared to earlier models, even after the key is released. I couldn't find any information about this behavior in the release notes. Has anyone else encountered this issue, and is there a way to ensure the cursor input is only active while the physical key is being pressed? Thanks in advance,
No, there is no way to adjust this. There are no available settings to change this behavior.

analysis.insight_summary: The user noticed that cursor key inputs on the newer [product_name] hardware remain active longer after key release than on previous models. This change was undocumented, and there is no configurable option to alter key input timing. The situation caused uncertainty and dissatisfaction because users were not informed and cannot adjust the behavior.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected cursor key inputs to deactivate as soon as the key is released, similar to earlier hardware. They hoped for a setting to adjust this or at least clear documentation describing the change.
